name: Swalwell Dam Campground
note: Kneehill County campground of 6 unserviced stalls on the west shore of the Swalwell Dam reservoir (Fyten's Reservoir), southwest of the hamlet of Swalwell, with a day-use area on the shore across the campground road; power boats are not allowed. No dump station on site (the nearest are in Torrington and Three Hills); potable water was unavailable for the 2026 season and the tap water had to be boiled. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Kneehill County page kneehillcounty.com/2199/Swalwell-Dam + FAQ (read 2026-11-10): county campground with camping stalls, picnic tables, fire pits and a day-use area, unserviced C$25, reservations through Let's Camp; Let's Camp camp swalwell-dam (read 2026-11-10): live, online bookings on, 6 reservable 'Unserviced Site - Swalwell' sites 1-6 for tent or RV, pads 40 x 20 ft, maxRvLength 40 ft; Esri imagery 2026-11-10: campground road along the shore off Range Road 244A with the stall strip beside it -> real drive-in county campground a 23-ft rig fits. Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 2026-11-10 (500 m crop and z18/z16 tiles around 51.54456,-113.33358, all rendered) + Let's Camp map and photos: the stalls line the west side of the campground road, between it and Range Road 244A; across the road a grassy day-use strip and a reed fringe run to the reservoir, 25-45 m from the stalls, open ground with no tree screen, and a Let's Camp photo shows the water from the campground road. Road and day-use strip between -> not on-water; open sightline -> lakeview. Dam about 200 m south; stalls on the reservoir side, DEM 867 m vs 863 m on the water.
fees_source: https://kneehillcounty.com/2199/Swalwell-Dam (read 2026-11-10): 'Camping Fees: Unserviced site- $25'; Let's Camp rules: fee schedule as posted includes GST. Let's Camp per-site rates read 0 off season.
flags: Not on RV Life (Algolia 5 km radius and name search find nothing).
Hookups: none (Let's Camp: every site water/sewer false, electrical null; map titled 'No Serviced Sites').

Season May-September; Let's Camp status 'closed' now, 2027 reservations open February/March 2027 (bio still carries the 2025 dates May 16 - Sep 14). Max stay 14 nights, min 1, check-in 1 pm / out 11 am.
Phone is the Kneehill County park host (in season, same as 9043); county office 403-443-5541 off season.
Site count: the county page says 10 camping stalls; Let's Camp's bio, site list and map show 6 (sites 1-6). 6 used in the note.
